September 13, 2026
Back again for another This Week in Television! This week has some stations launching new graphics, debut shows and a few new simulcasts. Enjoy!

0:00 KDBC CBS4 News at 5;30PM open - September 6, 2026
0:50 WTVA 9 News Today Weekend (Return) - September 5, 2026
2:20 WHPM FOX Pine Belt IDs

2:31 WNBC/WVIT The NewsZone open - September 7, 2026
3:23 KNBC News4 NewsZone open (Debut Show) - September 7, 2026
WNBC debuted this a week prior, but WVIT and KNBC debuted "The NewsZone" on September 7th (WVIT simulcasts the WNBC show). The format is similar to LiveNOW from FOX. Music is production music called "Sideline Reporter" from Kosinus Magazine.

4:25 KNBC NBC4 News at 2PM open (Debut Show) - September 7, 2026

5:19 WGBC Twin States News at 9PM open (New Graphics, Music & Voiceover) - September 7, 2026
6:18 WPBI-DT2 Star City News at 11PM open (New Graphics, Music & Voiceover) - September 8, 2026
All of Coastal's TV stations debuted a new look on August 28th, which included a new Envato template and production music "Meet The Challenge" from American Music Company. For WGBC and WPBI specifically, they switched to Glenn Hansen from Steve Davis as the voice artist. The News Hub green screen background got a refresh as well if you care lol.

7:31 WBBJ 7 Eyewitness News Good Morning West Tennessee Saturday open (Final) - September 5, 2026
8:48 WMC/WBBJ Action News 5 at 4AM open (New Simulcast)- September 8, 2026
10:08 WMC/WBBJ Action News 5 at 5AM Weekend open (New Simulcast) - September 12, 2026
Starting on Tuesday, September 8th, WBBJ started simulcasting the 4AM hour of WMC's morning show, while keeping their existing Good Morning West Tennessee newscast. WBBJ-ABC also now simulcasts the 4:30PM WMC newscast. Starting this weekend, WBBJ has ditched their weekend morning newscasts for simulcasts of WMC as well. WBBJ's existing newscasts remain unchanged.

11:16 KSFL Sioux Falls Live at 9PM open/close (New Newscast) - September 9, 2026
On September 7th, Forum's KSFL-TV debuted a local newscast for the area. This replaced the regional Forum News Network from WDAY on the station. Music used sounds like a production piece and the voiceover is the same unknown guy at WDAY.

14:47 KJCT News 8 at 5;30PM open (New Graphics & Music) - September 10, 2026
16:04 KATC/KADN Acadiana News First "More Than Just a Name" promo

16:34 WIFR/WREX News This Morning open - September 11, 2026
During this past week only, WREX started simulcasting WIFR's morning show, in preparation for their rebranding to Rockford News First come Monday. Station presentation remains the same.

17:44 WEVV 44News This Morning open (Final Morning Show) - September 11, 2026
20:48 WFIE/WEVV 14 News at 5PM open (New Simulcast) - September 11, 2026
Starting on Friday, September 11 at 4PM, WEVV started simulcasting WFIE's newscasts, effectively ending their news department for a second time in the station's history. WEVV aired their final morning and noon newscasts earlier within the day. As far as I'm aware, there was no mention of the change over-the-air. Station presentation remains the same.

recentItems.title: KMVT News at 5PM Open - New Graphics, Music & Voiceover | September 11, 2026
recentItems.description:
Join Broadcast Plaza for all things media-related: https://www.discord.gg/EvY9MPxsU5

The 5pm open from CBS affiliate KMVT in in Twin Falls, Idaho. 

Following the other former Gray stations this week, KMVT became the 18th station to debut the new "Scripps Keeper" look during their 5pm show on Friday, September 11th. KMVT/KSVT was acquired by Scripps earlier this year, after the company and Gray Media announced a trade of several stations last year. KMVT never debuted the GrayONE look, but got a new logo in 2023 that was based off the graphics package. Sister station KSAW/KIVI did not get this new look.

The new Scripps 2025 theme from 11 One/Music is the music. Unlike KKCO and KKTV who kept their current voice artists, KMVT opted to use the unknown male voiceover from Scripps. He replaces Bill Murray, who can still be heard in sponsor bumps.

The midday open from NBC affiliate KKCO in in Grand Junction, Colorado, also simulcast on sister station KJCT-LP.

Also to my complete shock, KKCO/KJCT became the 17th station to debut the new "Scripps Keeper" look during their midday show on Wednesday, September 9th. KKCO/KJCT was acquired by Scripps earlier this year, after the company and Gray Media announced a trade of several stations last year. KKCO/KJCT debuted the GrayONE package back in March of 2025.

The new Scripps 2025 theme from 11 One/Music is the music and KKCO/KJCT's voice artist Eric Gordon remains. The station opted not to use the unknown male voice artist that is currently going around the other Scripps stations.

recentItems.title: KKTV 11 News at 4PM Open - New Graphics & Music | September 8, 2026
recentItems.description:
Join Broadcast Plaza for all things media-related: https://www.discord.gg/EvY9MPxsU5

The 4pm open from CBS affiliate KKTV in Colorado Springs.

To my complete shock, KKTV became the 16th station to debut the new "Scripps Keeper" look on Tuesday, September 8th. KKTV was acquired by Scripps earlier this year, after the company and Gray Media announced a trade of several stations last year. KKTV debuted the GrayONE package back in April of 2024. The station also kept the mismatch of "11 News" and "11 Alert" brandings (even though the former is obviously better). Sister station KOAA did not debut this new look at the time of me writing this, but both stations are expected to merge under KKTV's building soon.

The new Scripps 2025 theme from 11 One/Music is the music and KKTV's voice artist Peter Dean remains. The station opted not to use the unknown male voice artist that is currently going around the other Scripps stations.

recentItems.title: WRIC Good Morning Richmond Open | September 8, 2026
recentItems.description:
Join Broadcast Plaza for all things media-related: https://www.discord.gg/EvY9MPxsU5

The 4:30am open from ABC affiliate WRIC licensed to Petersburg, Virginia, also serving the Richmond area.

On Monday, September 8th, WRIC announced that weekend anchor/reporter Madison Moore will be the new co-host for the weekday edition of Good Morning Richmond and the 9am show. Madison replaces Autumn Childress, as she left the station back in June. As of now, there is no dedicated weekend morning anchor.

Graphics from Nexstar remain and so does the music "Aerial" from Stephen Arnold Music. Tammy Lattin remains as the morning voiceover.

Anchored by Delaney Hall and Madison Moore. Weather with meteorologist Madison Olms and traffic with Nia McMillan.

September 6, 2026
Back again for another This Week in Television. This week features some news opens, many new voiceover changes and a debut newscast. Enjoy!

0:00 WNCN Wake Up Carolina (Rebrand) - August 24, 2026
On August 24th, WNCN rebranded their morning show to "Wake Up Carolina." The news content featured is mostly the same with a few lighter topics. The open was done by one of the creative hubs and graphics remain the "CBS_01" look. Music is "Waking Up My Day" from Stephen Arnold Music.

1:49 WKRN Good Morning Nashville Open - August 26, 2026
4:53 WEVV 44News at 10 Open - August 28, 2026
5:34 WFIE/WEVV 14News on FOX and CBS promo

6:04 WMAR 2 News at 10PM Open (New Voiceover) - August 31, 2026 
Within the past couple of days prior to this recording, WMAR switched to the new unknown voice artist who can be heard at some Scripps stations debuting the new "Keeper" look. The new music fron 11 One/Music can also be heard in the news tease. Station presentation otherwise remains the same.

7:16 WIAT All American Promo - September 1, 2026
7:47 WIAT Alabama's 42 News at 6PM Open, Talent Rejoin and Rejoin - September 1, 2026
WIAT assumed the CW affiliation from Sinclair's WTTO on September 1st, after previously losing CBS back on August 1st. Station presentation remains the same at this time.

9:24 KATC-TV 3 Acadiana's Newschannel ID - September 3, 2026

9:28 KJTL Texoma's FOX News at 9;00PM Open (New Voiceover) - September 3, 2026
Within the past 2-3 weeks, KJTL ditched their unknown male voice artist for Sean King, following most Nexstar stations in switching to the SpotVoice service. The station got rid of the Extreme sound effects they had with the previous voiceover as well lol. Station presentation remains the same.

10:52 KRON 4 News at 2PM Open (New Voiceover) - September 4, 2026 (they ran the wrong open, should've been 3)
11:48 KRON 4 News at 4PM Open (New Voiceover) - September 4, 2026
Recently, KRON ditched Josh Goodman for Steve Davis, following most Nexstar stations in switching to the SpotVoice. Steve Davis is local to the Bay Area, so this wasn't a bad choice. Station Presentation remains the same. 

12:40 WTSP 10 Tampa Bay News at 11PM Open (New Logo) - September 4, 2026
Earlier this week, WTSP dropped their retro-ish 10 from Matchstic for a more simple one. Looks even more like Australia's Network Ten now and sister station WBNS lol. Station presentation otherwise remains the same.

14:00 WHPM: WDAM 7 News at 9 on FOX Pine Belt Open (New Show) - September 2, 2026
On August 31st, WHPM ended their News Hub newscasts and WDAM started producing the 9pm show for them instead. This comes as Waypoint Media is in the process of selling WHPM to Gray Media, but Gray started operating the station as of this past week. They have rebranded from "FOX23" to "FOX Pine Belt." The graphics are the honeycomb look from Gray and music is "Inergy" from Stephen Arnold Music. Glenn Hansen is the voiceover. Sorry for the short tease, it got cut off.

No copyright infringement intended. For removal requests or questions, contact me using the email listed in my About section.

recentItems.title: WHSV Daybreak Open - New Graphics, Music & Logo | September 2, 2026
recentItems.description:
Join Broadcast Plaza for all things media-related: https://www.discord.gg/EvY9MPxsU5

The 6am open for ABC affiliate WHSV in Harrisonburg, Virginia.

Also starting off their September right, WHSV debuted the GrayONE look during their noon newscast. This replaces the honeycomb look they had since 2021. They also got a new logo with the "WHSV" call letters in the Termina font. The orange colors they use for the morning open look nice!

Music was also changed. They switched away from their newer "This Is The Place" cuts to "Aerial," both done by Stephen Arnold Music. David Kaye remains as the station's voice artist.

recentItems.title: KVLY/KXJB The Valley Today Open - New Graphics, Music & Voiceover | September 2, 2026
recentItems.description:
Join Broadcast Plaza for all things media-related: https://www.discord.gg/EvY9MPxsU5

The 4:30am open from NBC affiliate KVLY in Fargo, North Dakota, simulcast on sister CBS station KXJB-LD licensed to Horace, North Dakota.

Kicking off September 1st, KVLY debuted the GrayONE graphics during their 4pm newscast. Like their older look from the Gray graphics hub, they use a red and white color scheme to match their logo. Side note - I'm so glad they kept that logo, specifically the "V." I've always loved it.

They also switched away from "Icon News" by 615 Music, to "Ascend" from Stephen Arnold Music. Not heard on the news open, but Mike Martindale is the station's new voice artist, replacing their longtime unknown male voice artist.
